title: Thrown complete response assembly errors bypass the failed RESPOND terminal path
observed: No model call; complete output and confirmed journal retained. Terminal checkpoint cursor=1, budgetUsage.steps=1; acceptedDecision RESPOND step2 persists; native steps contain only TOOL1 SUCCEEDED. No injected store fault in these cases. Returned stop is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (or STATE_CONFLICT for mutated provenance).
cause: dispatchRespond records FAILED only for a returned stopReason. Selector validation or message-size exception escapes await composeResponse. The outer execute catch finalizes before dispatch stop advances/clears state.
required: Cover exceptions from accepted response context assembly/framing in native terminal-step handling; preserve refusal and whole results, without inventing response decision receipts or a second budget gate.

title: Native response model-result logging failure double-counts the model-call slot
observed: One actual RESPONSE invocation and one model result; returned modelCalls=2 and checkpoint budgetUsage.modelCalls=2; input/output usage=73/2 charged once; no decision receipt. Native FAILED RESPOND2 exists, stop INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
cause: Native beginModelRequest already increments the shared usage; unrecorded branch adds modelCalls again.
required: Keep native failure accounting truthful and single-owned; do not add a response admission gate.

title: Audit failures leave response terminal checkpoint inconsistent with returned outcome or native step cursor
observed: Reject only runtime.completed audit: returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE but saved checkpoint stopReason=COMPLETED, cursor2. Reject only step.completed RESPOND:SUCCEEDED audit: native RESPOND2 SUCCEEDED, result steps2, checkpoint cursor1 with accepted RESPOND2 and budgetUsage.steps2. Store stays healthy in both probes.
cause: Final checkpoint is saved before terminal audit can veto the result; step audit throws after native step write/count but before loop advances state.
required: Reconcile the acknowledged native outcome with terminal state when audit vetoes completion; preserve conservative stops and audit failure evidence.
